subject: Mutual action sprint: Quantum Health private offer + billing routing
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Eva Morales <eva@quantumhealth.com>, Procurement Team <procure@quantumhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Mutual action sprint: Quantum Health private offer + billing routing

Hi Eva / Procurement team —

Following our call, attached is a lightweight mutual action sprint (MAP) to get the Quantum Health proof-of-value -> commitment executed via a marketplace private offer. Key highlights in the attached QH_MAP_v1.xlsx:

- Recommended flow: 2-week technical eval (prod-like keyspaces) -> 4-week pilot (limited seats) -> production commitment via AWS Private Offer (Marketplace) or alternative invoice route.
- Billing routing options (please confirm preference):
  * AWS Private Offer (recommended for cloud-native procurement) — billing flows through AWS Marketplace (purchase order + AWS invoice).
  * Direct invoice to accounts-payable@quantumhealth.com — useful if you need SAP/AR integration and a single Redwood invoice.
- Compliance evidence: SOC2 summary attached (SOC2_Summary.pdf). Full artifacts available on request.
- Procurement milestones with proposed dates are in the spreadsheet (columns: owner, due date, deliverable).

Ask: can you confirm the procurement contact who will own the PO and whether Quantum prefers marketplace billing or direct invoice? If marketplace, do you want an AWS or Azure private offer (we can support both — we'll need vendor account IDs and billing contact).

Proposed next step: 30-minute kickoff on Wed 10/25 to align owners and lock dates. I can send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Account Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Mobile: (555) 213-9981

Attachments: QH_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2_Summary.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
From: Eva Morales <eva@quantumhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@quantumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Oct 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action sprint: Quantum Health private offer + billing routing

Grace —

Thanks for the MAP and the SOC2 summary. This looks helpful. A few clarifications from procurement before we lock a kickoff: 

1) Marketplace vs invoice: Our default is AWS Marketplace private offers, but our legal/procurement team will need a 60-day price commitment window and a sample contract/SOW to review.
2) Can you provide a line-item billing schedule (month 1, month 2 pilot, monthly unit pricing) we can give Finance?
3) We will need Redwood to accept our PO terms; can you share a sample SOW and any standard procurement exceptions you commonly accept?

Attaching our internal preliminary requirements doc (Quantum_prelim_requirements.docx) — it lists a couple of technical gating items (IP allowlist, data retention window, audit log access).

Procurement contact: Ilya Petrov (procure@quantumhealth.com) is on this thread and will pick up PO logistics. Please CC accounts-payable@quantumhealth.com on the final invoice routing.

If you can get the sample SOW and an itemized price breakdown by EOD Friday 10/26 we can target the kickoff for Tue 10/31.

—Eva Morales
Head of Data Platforms
Quantum Health

Attachment: Quantum_prelim_requirements.docx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Eva Morales <eva@quantumhealth.com>, Ilya Petrov <procure@quantumhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Oct 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action sprint: Quantum Health private offer + billing routing

Eva / Ilya —

Thanks — quick responses inline and an operational plan.

Marketplace vs Direct Invoice
- AWS Private Offer: Our recommendation for fastest procurement without changes to your AR stack. We can set the private offer with a 60-day price lock and standard Marketplace T&Cs. Procurement typically provides vendor AWS account ID + PO number; AWS handles invoicing.
- Direct Invoice: Redwood can invoice Quantum Health directly (monthly). This route is common when customers require a single consolidated invoice for SAP ingestion; in that case we need AP contact + SOC2 + vendor W-9 (we can provide).

Itemized pricing (high level; I will follow with a line-by-line in the sample SOW):
- Technical eval (2 weeks): waived as part of pilot (no charge)
- Pilot (4 weeks): $7,500 fixed for pilot setup + $0.015/token overage
- Production seat commit: tiered unit pricing starting at $0.007/token equivalent (will tabulate in SOW)

Proposed mutual-action sprint with owners/dates (please confirm):
- 10/24: Redwood sends sample SOW + itemized pricing (owner: Karthik) — DONE (see attached sample SOW).
- 10/26: Quantum confirms preferred billing route + provides vendor AWS account ID and PO cadence (owner: Ilya).
- 10/31: Technical kickoff (owner: Grace / Quantum Eng).
- 11/15: Target PO issuance for private offer (owner: Quantum Procure).
- 11/30: Expected private-offer activation & billing route confirmation (owner: Redwood).

Action items for Redwood: attach Sample_SOW_Redwood.docx (included), full SOC2 artifacts on request, and a draft private-offer template if AWS path chosen.

If the team wants, Grace and I can run a 20-minute walkthrough of the SOW tomorrow.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Sample_SOW_Redwood.docx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Oct 2028 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Mutual action sprint: Quantum Health private offer + billing routing

Karthik / Monica —

Looping Monica to own the MAP spreadsheet cleanup and the DocuSign subscription order once we get confirmation from Quantum. Monica, please: 
- Update QH_MAP_v1.xlsx with the owners and due dates Karthik listed and convert to a simple checklist tab.
- Prepare a DocuSign envelope for the subscription order (we will pre-fill billing contact fields and link to the PO number when provided).
- Coordinate with Security to surface full SOC2 artifacts for procurement (I flagged the SOC2_Summary request).

I'll schedule the 10/31 kickoff once Eva confirms calendar availability. Thanks for owning these.

-Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Account Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Eva Morales <eva@quantumhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ilya Petrov <procure@quantumhealth.com>, accounts-payable@quantumhealth.com
Date: Fri, 02 Nov 2028 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action sprint: Quantum Health private offer + billing routing

Grace / Karthik —

We are aligned to proceed via AWS Private Offer. Procurement confirmed they will raise a PO and aim to issue it by 2028-11-15. A couple of final asks: 

- Please send the finalized line-item pricing table and the DocuSign-ready subscription order (we will attach the PO number to it).
- Invoice routing: accounts-payable@quantumhealth.com — please ensure remittance instructions and Redwood tax/Vendor info are included on the invoice.
- Legal: we will route the sample SOW to legal. If Redwood accepts two small procurement exceptions (standard warranty clause and liability cap tweaks) we can close faster — I can circulate the redlines next week.

Attaching our PO template for reference (QH_PO_Template.pdf). We will target the 11/15 PO and message updates if anything slips.

Best,
Eva

Attachment: QH_PO_Template.pdf
